note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. This engine repurposes the `redirect` recommendation to mean 'Accept with safety caution' (not 'send elsewhere') — it fires whenever prepSafetyBand is 'caution', including when a high-dose study lifts an otherwise-clean request from 'ok' to 'caution' on dose alone.

personas.name: routine-thyroid-function-thyroid-uptake-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine referral: biochemical hyperthyroidism with a goitre, thyroid uptake is the recommended (ideal) scan for the thyroid-function indication and carries a low radiation dose, no pregnancy/breastfeeding/renal concerns, every completeness field including the IR(ME)R justification present — expect usually-appropriate + ok prep safety + low dose + routine + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Biochemical hyperthyroidism with a palpable goitre — assess thyroid uptake to differentiate Graves disease from a toxic nodule.
request.relevantHistory: No previous thyroid imaging. Not on amiodarone.

justification.irMeRJustification: Clinically indicated to characterise hyperthyroidism; benefit outweighs the low radiation dose.

triage.notes: TFTs and TSH receptor antibodies already sent.

firedRules.description: Requested thyroid-uptake scan is the recommended examination for "thyroid-function".
A thyroid-uptake scan carries a low effective-dose band.
No preparation or radiation-safety concerns identified.
No acuity escalation; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

personas.name: urgent-cardiac-ischaemia-myocardial-perfusion-high-dose-caution
personas.description: Exertional chest tightness with an equivocal exercise ECG: myocardial perfusion imaging is the recommended (ideal) scan for the cardiac-ischaemia indication, and the indication itself auto-escalates triage to urgent regardless of the routine urgency requested; the scan's high effective-dose band alone lifts an otherwise-clean prep-safety band from ok to caution, which this engine's `redirect` recommendation represents as 'Accept with safety caution' rather than sending the request elsewhere — expect usually-appropriate + caution prep safety + high dose + urgent + redirect (accept with caution).

request.clinicalQuestion: Exertional chest tightness with an equivocal exercise ECG — assess for reversible myocardial ischaemia.
request.relevantHistory: Hypertension and hypercholesterolaemia. No previous myocardial infarction.

justification.irMeRJustification: Clinically indicated to investigate possible reversible ischaemia; benefit outweighs the high radiation dose given the non-diagnostic exercise ECG.

triage.notes: Beta-blockers withheld for 48 hours pre-test per protocol.

firedRules.description: Requested myocardial-perfusion scan is the recommended examination for "cardiac-ischaemia".
A myocardial-perfusion scan carries a high effective-dose band.
High effective-dose study — ensure justification and ALARA optimisation.

flags.description: Requested study carries a high effective radiation dose.
flags.suggestedAction: Confirm IR(ME)R justification and optimise administered activity (ALARA).

personas.name: reject-suspected-bone-metastases-bone-scan-pregnant-incomplete
personas.description: Known breast cancer with new back pain in a patient confirmed 10 weeks pregnant: a bone scan is the recommended (ideal) examination for the suspected-bone-metastases indication — there is no appropriateness mismatch here — but confirmed pregnancy makes radionuclide administration contraindicated pending justification, and this engine's distinctive `reject` recommendation fires from the prep-safety contraindication ahead of any appropriateness or completeness check; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + contraindicated prep safety + moderate dose + routine + reject, completeness below 100.

request.relevantHistory: Known breast cancer, new back pain — assess for bone metastases. Currently 10 weeks pregnant, confirmed by urine hCG.

triage.notes: Oncology aware; the scan should be deferred or alternative non-ionising imaging considered given confirmed pregnancy.

firedRules.description: Requested bone-scan scan is the recommended examination for "suspected-bone-metastases".
A bone-scan scan carries a moderate effective-dose band.
Confirmed pregnancy — radionuclide administration is contraindicated pending justification.
No acuity escalation; triage follows the requested urgency (routine).

flags.suggestedAction: Do not administer until justified by a nuclear-medicine physician; consider alternative non-ionising imaging.
Query the referrer for the specific question the scan should answer.
Obtain the referrer justification before the practitioner authorises the exposure.
